leo-ml: Hey legal/devs — bringing up ember-spark-13b for onboarding. Upstream license looks like a custom 'ANV1 (Attribution-NonCommercial v1)'. Quick questions: can we host quantized weights for Dedicated customers? Can customers get the quantized weights to run in Private? Any attribution requirements for model-card or UI?

maria-legal: Quick read: ANV1 prohibits commercial redistribution and requires attribution. TL;DR: hosting inference (we run the model and serve responses) is OK; handing out weights to customers is probably NOT allowed without an explicit redistribution grant. Need to ask upstream for a redistrib license if we want to distribute weights.

aj-eng: To confirm infra semantics: Dedicated = we operate the model on our infra for the customer (no weight handoff). Private = customer runs on their infra and typically receives the binaries/weights. So Private as-is looks like redistribution unless customer brings their own copy.

devon-ops: FWIW our current Private installer packages `ember-spark-13b-quant.pt` into the artifact. If licence forbids distribution we can switch to a customer-download flow where installer pulls weights from upstream directly into customer VPC.

maria-legal: Two pragmatic paths: (1) Stop packaging weights in our deliverable; require customer to download from upstream after accepting upstream EULA (we provide checksum/installer hooks). (2) Negotiate an enterprise redistribution grant with upstream. Also need an attribution banner + metadata in the model card. Example attribution snippet to show in UI and metadata: ```
Model: Ember-Spark-13B (ANV1)
Attribution: "Ember-Spark-13B by EmberAI, used under ANV1"
```

sara-research: Quick related Q — for quantization/eval experiments, are we OK to store quantized checkpoints internally for benchmarking and perf debugging? This would be internal-only, not customer-facing.

maria-legal: Internal benchmarking/storage is allowed under ANV1 so long as the weights are not redistributed externally. Recommend strict ACLs, access logs, and minimize retention.

aj-eng: license-bot scan on model repo:
license-bot: FOUND: license.txt = 'ANV1 (custom)'; notice.txt present; redistrib grant = NONE :warning:

leo-ml: Ok — plan of action: 1) Block packaging weights in Private deliverables, 2) implement customer-download flow for Private, 3) add attribution metadata in model catalog/UI, 4) ask upstream for enterprise redistrib quote. Filing tickets now. :thumbsup: 

devon-ops: I'll open a PR to change packaging and add `license: ANV1` tags in infra manifests.

sara-research: I'll mark the eval runs as internal-only and update the harness to strip checkpoints from artifacts before archiving.

maria-legal: Ping me if upstream responds or asks for negotiation. Keep an audit trail of requests and responses. :white_check_mark:
